name: Smart Media Request with AI Parsing

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.value:
=You are a media title extractor with knowledge of popular movies and TV shows. Extract the title and determine if it's a movie or TV show.

User request: "{{ $json.request_text }}"

Rules:
1. Extract the exact title from the request
2. Remove words like "request", "the movie", "the show", "season", "episode"
3. Preserve proper capitalization
4. Use your knowledge to determine media type:
   - If you KNOW it's a TV series/show, set "tv"
   - If you KNOW it's a movie, set "movie"
   - If mentions "season" or "episode", it's "tv"
   - If completely unknown and no season/episode mentioned, guess "movie"

Common TV shows: Breaking Bad, Game of Thrones, Stranger Things, The Office, Friends, Severance, Silo, The Last of Us, The Boys, Fallout, 3 Body Problem, Westworld, Black Mirror

Common movies: The Matrix, Inception, Interstellar, The Dark Knight, Avatar, Dune

Respond with ONLY valid JSON:
{"media_type": "movie or tv", "title": "Exact Title"}

Examples:
"Request The Matrix" -> {"media_type": "movie", "title": "The Matrix"}
"request severance" -> {"media_type": "tv", "title": "Severance"}
"request stranger things" -> {"media_type": "tv", "title": "Stranger Things"}
"request breaking bad season 1" -> {"media_type": "tv", "title": "Breaking Bad"}
"request fallout" -> {"media_type": "tv", "title": "Fallout"}

Now extract from: "{{ $json.request_text }}"
JSON:

nodes.name: AI - Select Best Result
nodes.notes: AI agent analyzes search results and user intent to select the most appropriate media item
